## Hypothesis

The shotgun_scalper strategy captures intraday premium fluctuations via volatility-filtered entries, premium-based stops/targets, and time stops. The edge exists in short-term mean reversion or momentum bursts in SPY 0DTE options, particularly when volume expands beyond average (vol_ratio_threshold > 1.2) and premium moves favorably.

## Mechanism

**Entry triggers:**  
- Volume ratio (current 5m volume / 20-bar avg volume) > vol_ratio_threshold (1.2)  
- Premium-based entry logic (implied from shotgun_scalper core)  

**Exit logic:**  
- Premium stop: stop_premium_pct (-0.35) → 35% premium loss  
- Premium take profit: tp_premium_pct (0.75) → 75% premium gain  
- Chandelier profit-lock: arms at chandelier_arm_pct (0.6) → 60% gain, trails 15% off HWM  
- Time stop: time_stop_min (12) → exit after 12 minutes if not stopped out  
- Strike selection: strike_offset (2) → OTM-2 put
